name: ABB Stop
description: Stop RAPID execution on an ABB controller once per button press. Calls stop on the rising edge of the stop button, so a held or recomputed True never re-issues it. The stop is immediate: no arming ceremony and no readback.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: RWS session from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected stops nothing and yields no error.

inputParameters.name: stop
inputParameters.description: Connect a Button; a True fires the stop once. A held or recomputed True never re-issues the stop.

outputParameters.name: status
outputParameters.description: Short status string of the stop that just fired, e.g. 'stopped'. Empty until the next press.
